title: Ham and Cheese Pinwheels
description: Pizza dough rolled with smoked bacon lardons and grated Cheddar, sliced and baked into crispy pinwheels. Great as a snack or light meal.
steps: Roll the pizza dough into a large rectangle, around 30cm x 40cm.
Cook the lardons/pancetta and allow to cool before scattering over the dough. Grate the cheese and scatter over too, leaving a few cm free at top and bottom.
Starting at the bottom edge, roll the dough upwards into a tight cylinder. Seal the outer edge by squeezing. Refrigerate for 30 minutes.
Preheat the oven to 200°C/180°C fan. Line a baking sheet with greaseproof paper.
Cut the chilled dough into 1cm-thick slices. Lay flat on the sheet and bake for 30 minutes until crisp and cheese has melted.
Serve hot with plenty of ketchup.
